Two independent audit findings prevent K1_1 from freezing:

(1) Real XML attribute parsing is not quote-equivalent. `.claude/scripts/lib.cjs` only parses double-quoted attributes, and `.claude/scripts/check-manifests.cjs` separately parses `<Project Sdk="...">` with a double-quote-only regex. Consequently, a single-quoted `PackageReference` carrying an inline version or EF Core/ASP.NET dependency, `FrameworkReference` or Web SDK bypasses policy, while `PackageVersion` loses its ID/version and can falsely reject valid exact versions; valid `ProjectReference` using single quotes can be incorrectly treated as a self-reference and rejected. Fix the COMMON attribute-reading contract, not a few package-name strings. Test both quote styles, mixed attributes, ordering, and safe negative/positive manifests via the real checker and PostToolUse/PostToolUseFailure in isolated Git repositories.

(2) `.claude/scripts/check-manifests.cjs` treats `TBD` and `pending` in the Date column of the `## Accepted decisions` table as accepted approval dates. This wrongly lets `dotnet add Foo.Api.csproj reference Foo.Domain.csproj` pass PreToolUse. A Reserved reference change is authorized ONLY by a valid dated accepted-decision row (and its linked record). Test valid dates vs placeholders, missing/invalid dates, and unrelated records through real PreToolUse; do not alter decision ownership or create a second approval surface.

Restrict template edits to `.claude/scripts/lib.cjs` and `.claude/scripts/check-manifests.cjs` unless a directly demonstrated unavoidable defect requires another file. Keep the other 85 original files byte-identical; no architecture rewrite, new Kind/Scope/capability slot, hook/settings rewrite, policy change, or speculative cleanup. Preserve D1-D13, the 194+2 policies, ENF graph, Binds on required leaves, 4 slots, optional frontend, real worktree and failed-shell behavior, command classifier and Stop deduplication. The first-iteration 324-test count is historical evidence, not a harness to reconstruct.

Use ONE finite local test harness in `output/.work/`: reproduce the audit counterexamples against iteration 1, implement the narrow fixes, verify discriminating rejects AND allowed cases, execute focused preservation checks, then ONE final cumulative audit on stable bytes. Real FAIL cases must report the relevant problem, not an incidental parse/config error. Correct a test-oracle mistake once if necessary; do not let a harness mistake cause unbounded verification or re-audit cycles.
